pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.body: The regression test can report success even though the concurrent read produced the NPE/500 it is supposed to detect, so the fixed bug can silently regress without the test failing.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test provides no reliable signal; regressions in concurrent group reads pass CI.
raw_findings.impact: The regression test can report success even though the concurrent read produced the NPE/500 it is supposed to detect, so the fixed bug can silently regress without the test failing.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new test publishes the stop flag and asserts on shared state without synchronizing on the worker thread's termination.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep a reference to the created `Thread`, call `thread.join()` (with a timeout) after `deletedAll.set(true)` and before `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())`.
raw_findings.title: Concurrency test asserts before the reader thread finishes, allowing false passes
raw_findings.trigger: The main thread sets `deletedAll` to true and immediately evaluates the assertion while the spawned reader thread still has an in-flight `groups(...)` admin REST call that only fails (and adds to `caughtExceptions`) after the assertion has executed.

raw_findings.body: The non-daemon reader thread keeps spinning on admin REST calls forever, preventing JVM exit and hanging the test run instead of failing fast.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Build hangs indefinitely rather than reporting a test failure.
raw_findings.impact: The non-daemon reader thread keeps spinning on admin REST calls forever, preventing JVM exit and hanging the test run instead of failing fast.
raw_findings.root_cause: Stop-flag publication is placed on the happy path only and the worker thread is created with default (non-daemon) semantics.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the deletion loop in `try { ... } finally { deletedAll.set(true); }` and mark the reader thread as daemon (`thread.setDaemon(true)`) before starting it.
raw_findings.title: Reader thread is non-daemon and the stop flag is not set in a finally block, risking a hung test JVM
raw_findings.trigger: If any `managedRealm.admin().groups().group(groupUuid).remove()` call in the deletion loop throws (e.g. 404/500 due to the very concurrency the test exercises), the exception propagates out of `forEach`, `deletedAll.set(true)` on the next line is never reached.

raw_findings.body: `GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount()` is documented as "Never returns {@code null}", yet this implementation returns null; `GroupRepresentation.subGroupCount` becomes null for the deleted group and any caller unboxing the `Long` (or relying on the documented contract) throws NullPointerException instead of seeing 0.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Contract-breaking null leaks into representations and can move the NPE from the model layer to callers.
raw_findings.impact: `GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount()` is documented as "Never returns {@code null}", yet this implementation returns null; `GroupRepresentation.subGroupCount` becomes null for the deleted group and any caller unboxing the `Long` (or relying on the documented contract) throws NullPointerException instead of seeing 0.
raw_findings.root_cause: The null-guard added by the fix propagates null out of a method whose SPI contract forbids null instead of substituting a neutral count.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Return `0L` when the model is no longer present (`return model == null ? 0L : model.getSubGroupsCount();`), or update the `GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount()` javadoc and all callers to handle null explicitly.
raw_findings.title: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount now returns null, violating the documented non-null contract
raw_findings.trigger: A cached group is removed by a concurrent transaction, so `modelSupplier.get()` resolves to null and the admin endpoints (`GroupsResource.getGroups`, `GroupResource.getGroup`) call `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` on that adapter.

raw_findings.body: The reported NPE (issue #40368) still occurs for the children/subgroup listing endpoints, so the fix is incomplete and the admin API can still return HTTP 500 during concurrent group deletion.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Same crash path remains reachable after the patch; regression is only partially closed.
raw_findings.impact: The reported NPE (issue #40368) still occurs for the children/subgroup listing endpoints, so the fix is incomplete and the admin API can still return HTTP 500 during concurrent group deletion.
raw_findings.root_cause: The defensive null resolution was introduced for one accessor only rather than for the shared `modelSupplier.get()` dereference pattern in this class.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Apply the same null handling (return an empty stream when `modelSupplier.get()` is null) in the three `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads, e.g. via a shared private helper that resolves the delegate model.
raw_findings.title: Null-guard applied only to getSubGroupsCount, leaving identical NPE in adjacent getSubGroupsStream overloads
raw_findings.trigger: The same concurrent group deletion that makes `modelSupplier.get()` return null is reached through `GroupResource.getSubGroups` -> `group.getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, -1, -1)`, which still executes `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` on lines 256/262/268 without the new null check.

raw_findings.body: The typo ("Uuu") makes the identifier hard to search for and is inconsistent with the surrounding `groupUuid` naming used in the same method.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Reduced readability and inconsistent naming in newly added test code.
raw_findings.impact: The typo ("Uuu") makes the identifier hard to search for and is inconsistent with the surrounding `groupUuid` naming used in the same method.
raw_findings.root_cause: Typographical error introduced when adding the new test's local variable.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Rename the variable to `groupUuids` at its declaration and both usages.
raw_findings.title: Misspelled local variable groupUuuids in the new test
raw_findings.trigger: Reading or extending the new `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti` test, where the identifier is used again on lines 129 and 152.

raw_findings.body: Unthrottled full-listing requests add significant CPU/DB load to the shared test server, slowing the suite and increasing the chance of unrelated timeouts in parallel tests.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test-suite resource contention and increased flakiness/runtime.
raw_findings.impact: Unthrottled full-listing requests add significant CPU/DB load to the shared test server, slowing the suite and increasing the chance of unrelated timeouts in parallel tests.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new concurrency test uses an unbounded busy-wait polling loop rather than a throttled, paged read.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a small sleep/back-off inside the loop and bound the page size (for example `groups(null, 0, 200, true)`) instead of `Integer.MAX_VALUE`.
raw_findings.title: Reader thread busy-loops with no pause and requests Integer.MAX_VALUE results per call
raw_findings.trigger: The test runs the loop continuously for the whole duration of the 100 sequential group deletions, each iteration issuing an unbounded (`max = Integer.MAX_VALUE`) group listing request against the test server.
